info.name: Emisell Payment Platform API v1
info.description: Emisell Internal Gateway and private Partner API in one collection. Public service traffic, private admin control-plane traffic, and isolated connector traffic use separate base URL variables. Every request includes an example response; secret current values are intentionally not exported.

item.name: 00 · Dashboard Administration
item.description: Endpoint administratif untuk operator Payment Proxy. Jangan dipanggil dari Emisell Backend atau aplikasi publik.

item.name: Main Service API Keys
item.description: Kelola Bearer credential full-access untuk komunikasi Emisell Backend ke /api/v1/*. Secret hanya muncul sekali saat generate.

request.description: Mengembalikan metadata dan fingerprint tersamarkan. Plaintext key tidak pernah dikembalikan.
Membuat random 256-bit key berprefix epk_. Postman menyimpan secret ke collection variable agar endpoint /api/v1/* dapat langsung diuji. Salin ke secret manager Emisell sebelum response ditutup.
Mencabut akses secara langsung tanpa restart Payment Proxy. Gunakan key baru di Emisell sebelum melakukan revoke saat rotasi.

item.name: Provider Apps
item.description: Provider-first registry dan lifecycle connector bundle. Buat identitas provider, lalu upload versi ZIP di bawah provider tersebut; binary tidak disimpan di collection export.

body.raw:
{
  "provider_code": "{{provider_app_code}}",
  "provider_name": "Connector Demo",
  "description": "Provider connector registered before ZIP submission.",
  "website_url": "https://example.com",
  "documentation_url": "https://example.com/docs",
  "support_email": "support@example.com"
}

request.description: Provider code menjadi identitas permanen. Nama dan code manifest ZIP berikutnya wajib cocok.
Memindai ZIP dan memastikan manifest code/name cocok dengan provider pada URL. Bundle tidak dieksekusi di Payment Kernel.
Membaca ulang artifact immutable dan memverifikasi digest, manifest, serta seluruh checksum.
Publish hanya berhasil bila runtime memuat provider code dan exact manifest version yang sama.

response.name: 409 Runtime not ready

request.description: Satu record per provider dengan active/latest version dan jumlah versi; tidak pernah mengembalikan binary artifact.
Submission history untuk satu provider, termasuk release lama/deprecated.

item.name: Engine Observability & SLO
item.description: Snapshot process dan format Prometheus. Gunakan admin key melalui header, bukan query string.

request.description: Process-local HTTP availability/latency, connector outcomes, dan provider webhook counters. Counter reset saat process restart.
Prometheus exposition format untuk scraper internal.
Database, connector registry, runtime configuration, dan request guard efektif tanpa secret.

item.name: 01 · Emisell Internal Gateway (Active)
item.description: Endpoint aktif antara Emisell Backend dan Payment Proxy. Base path utama /api/v1/*.

request.description: Kontrak machine-readable untuk connector, operation, credential field, dan certification profile yang tersedia pada runtime.
Mengembalikan provider registry dan dynamic credential schema.

Credential diverifikasi langsung ke provider dan dienkripsi AES-256-GCM di vault Emisell. Atur topik Payments API v3 – Payment Status, Payment Request Status, Payment Session Completed, dan Payment Session Expired di Xendit Dashboard ke endpoint installation, lalu isi webhook token. Secret tidak pernah dikembalikan API.
Installation harus INACTIVE. Target harus RELEASED dan sama dengan manifest runtime aktif; credential tetap tersimpan terenkripsi. Setelah response READY, aktifkan kembali dengan version terbaru.
Menghapus ciphertext credential lalu melakukan soft-uninstall. Installation ACTIVE harus dideaktivasi terlebih dahulu; riwayat transaksi dan audit tetap dipertahankan.
List bukti certification tenant-scoped dan blocker execution engine.

Menjalankan create, next action, retrieve, simulator atau customer authorization, direct provider webhook, dan signed delivery ke Emisell Backend. E-wallet dapat mengembalikan BLOCKED sampai halaman sandbox provider diselesaikan.
Setelah redirect atau mobile authorization sandbox selesai, verifikasi provider status, provider webhook, dan signed Emisell delivery untuk payment yang sama. Endpoint ini tidak membuat payment baru.

response.name: 201 E-wallet passed

request.description: Master canonical payment methods dan capability matrix Xendit, Midtrans, Duitku, serta DOKU. Hanya status CERTIFIED yang boleh di-assign.

item.name: 2. Assign master method to active gateway

request.description: Membuat atau memindahkan QRIS ke satu gateway aktif pada environment merchant. Kirim version terakhir untuk optimistic concurrency.
Daftar konfigurasi metode pembayaran merchant, termasuk assignment yang sedang inactive.
Endpoint checkout. Hanya mengembalikan opsi aktif yang terhubung ke installation aktif. Checkout menyimpan id yang opaque, bukan provider_code.
Menutup opsi checkout baru. Payment lama tetap terikat ke installation yang dipilih ketika payment dibuat.

response.name: 202 Outcome unknown

request.description: Set card_payment_option_id dari assignment card yang ACTIVE. Response berisi hosted Xendit redirect_url. Jangan pernah menambahkan nomor kartu, expiry, CVV/CVN, atau OTP ke request ini; input tersebut hanya dilakukan pelanggan pada domain checkout Xendit.
List canonical payments with provider, status, search, execution-mode, and pagination filters.
Durable payment state history with source and timestamps.

exec: pm.test('Xendit QRIS refund is gated', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(422));

request.description: Kontrak refund generik. Xendit native v1 saat ini menghasilkan 422 REFUND_NOT_SUPPORTED sebelum diteruskan ke connector.

response.name: 422 Xendit QRIS not supported

request.description: Reads Callback URL, enabled state, masked secret, and last connection test. Plaintext secret is never returned.
Callback URL is entered manually. Keep enabled=false until the receiver has the generated secret and the signed test succeeds.

item.name: Generate or rotate Emisell webhook secret

request.description: Returns a whsec_ plaintext once, stores only AES-GCM ciphertext, and disables delivery during rotation. Copy the secret immediately to Emisell Backend.
Sends a signed canonical webhook.test event without customer, order, payment, or provider credential data.

response.name: 200 Test accepted

request.description: Metadata webhook tenant-scoped. Raw payload tetap encrypted dan tidak dikirim dalam response.

exec: pm.test('Emisell receiver accepted canonical event', () => pm.expect([200, 202]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Contract test untuk endpoint yang harus dibangun di Emisell Backend. Signature dihitung dari timestamp + '.' + raw body. Gunakan receiver development lokal atau URL backend sandbox; jangan gunakan endpoint provider ingress.
Canonical outbox event dan metadata delivery menuju Emisell Backend.
Hanya delivery DEAD dapat direplay. Consumer Emisell wajib idempotent.
Tenant-scoped queue untuk payment/refund UNKNOWN, delivery DEAD, webhook FAILED, dan installation ERROR.

Mengambil payment ID yang sama langsung dari provider lalu menerapkan status canonical, timeline, reconciliation counter, dan audit secara atomic. Tidak membuat payment pengganti dan tidak melakukan failover.

item.name: 02 · Partner API Contract
item.description: ACTIVE private contract from Payment Kernel to the isolated Connector Runner on /partner/v1/*. All requests use CONNECTOR_RUNNER_TOKEN and must remain on a private network; production requires TLS.

request.description: ACTIVE. Probe ringan tanpa memanggil provider upstream.
ACTIVE. Manifest runtime tetap memerlukan sertifikasi Emisell sebelum method ditampilkan di checkout.
Runtime Midtrans terpisah. Manifest version dan executable_sha256 dipakai publish gate untuk membuktikan container identik dengan ZIP certified.
ACTIVE. Secret hanya diproses pada isolated Connector Runner, tidak dicatat, dan tidak dikembalikan pada response.
ACTIVE. Ambiguous timeout menjadi OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; jangan membuat transaksi kedua.
ACTIVE ingress milik Payment Proxy. Payload dan signature mengikuti provider.
ACTIVE. Connector mengembalikan event minimal canonical; raw payload tidak diteruskan ke Emisell Backend.
